columns.name: monthly_net_burn
columns.comment: CASH delta month-over-month, NOT operating spend. Reconciles to MONTHLY_BURN only as sum(MONTHLY_BURN categories) - revenue = monthly_net_burn. A residual remains in most months, up to ~$47K in either direction. Treat it as unexplained cash movement in a P&L that stopped being maintained in 2025 -- its UA row omits $46,201.50 of bank-confirmed wires.

columns.name: headcount
columns.comment: NON-FOUNDER PAYEES at that month end - the population company.headcount_peak_paid and company.headcount_actual_tail both count, and it reads 16 at the 2024-09 peak. COMPOSITION, because the total alone misleads: it is non-founder FULL-TIME staff PLUS non-founder CONTRACTORS, counted as distinct people - 2024-09 is 12 full-time + 4 contractors. Only the three co-founders are excluded, so ALL PEOPLE = this + 3, peaking at 19. That 19 is the warehouse's answer to company.headcount_peak_concurrent, whose quoted "21 people including contractors" is kind=REPORTED with a band of 19-21 - 21 is the top of that band, not a realised count

rec.name: DIM_DEVICE

columns.name: device_model_generic

columns.name: est_market_value_usd
columns.comment: Estimated retail value used for LTV/segmentation
